text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 108, December 03, 1947 ]
REORGANIZING THE LIGHTHOUSE BOARD
In order to systematize and coordinate the rehabilitation, establishment and improvement of lighthouses and
other aids to navigation in the Philippines, I, MANUEL ROXAS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the
powers vested in me by law, do hereby reorganize the Lighthouse Board to be composed of the Director of
Coast and Geodetic Survey, as Chairman; and the Commander, Philippine Naval Patrol; the Lighthouse
Supervisor, Lighthouse Service, Philippine Naval Patrol; the Surveyor of Port, Bureau of Customs; the
Supervising Port Works Engineer, Bureau of Public Works; the President of the Philippines Ship Owner’s
Association, or his representative; and the President, Ocean- going Steamship Lines Association in the
Philippines, or his representative, as members.
The duties of this Board shall be as follows:
1. To determine upon the location and type of lighthouses, buoys, or beacons to be established or constructed
in the Philippines.
2. To prescribe and recommend the standards and orders of lights and other aids to navigation in the
Philippines.
3. To pass upon all applications for the establishment or improvement of lighthouses and other aids to
navigation.
4. To prescribe and recommend operating procedures and testing of lighthouse equipment and other aid to
navigation.
5. To study and submit recommendations regarding electronic aids to navigation and similar new devices.
6. To prescribe and recommend the establishment of electronic aids similar new devices.
7. To recommend operating procedures regarding the establishment, servicing, and maintenance of
lighthouses, electronic devices, and other aids to navigation.
8. To study and submit recommendations to the Office of the President for the improvement of aids to
navigation and the lighthouse service in general.
9. To prepare recommendations to the President as to the ways and means to accomplish the decisions reached
by the Board.
